nodes.label: Push-to-Talk vs Voice Activity Detection
nodes.rationale: PTT gives deterministic turn boundaries and tolerates learner hesitation; VAD can clip speech or end turns during pauses.

nodes.label: ASR Leniency Tension / Strictness Setting
nodes.rationale: Lenient ASR motivates beginners but is useless to advanced learners; a strictness setting or level-dependent thresholds addresses both.
